# Third-party code

| File | What | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `../studio/blockly/` | Blockly 13.4.0 (`blockly_compressed.js`, `blocks_compressed.js`, `msg/en.js`, `media/`), from https://www.npmjs.com/package/blockly | Apache 2.0, see `../studio/blockly/LICENSE` |
| `stb_image.h` | v2.30 of Sean Barrett's image loader (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF), from https://github.com/nothings/stb | public domain or MIT (your choice), see the end of the file |

Flaux uses it to load pictures for `image(...)` in graphics programs.

Flaux Studio uses Blockly for its block editor (Blocks mode).
